title: H-1 / MC-1 FE-derived B(z): preregistered magnetostatic evaluation (A9.38 P3)

A9.38.note: P3: replace the P5-shape surrogate with the best admissible H1-specific B(z); FEMM-derived first, measured when hardware exists; keep surrogate and actual-field results separated

A9.14 F5-OQ-01.note: YES_FEMM_ANALYSIS_POINTS_NOT_SELECTION: FEMM-class axisymmetric magnetostatics at the RP-1 anchor (an authorised analysis point, h1_freeze_candidate femm_analysis_points); use sourced B-H; do not infer Hall performance from magnetic feasibility

what_this_is: the evaluation plan for an FE-derived vacuum B(z) of the registered H-1 / MC-1 electromagnet at the RP-1 anchor: geometry and material basis, solver and pins, verification cases, mesh convergence, outputs, uncertainty propagation over the registered assumption ranges, acceptance against H1F-BZ-02 / H1F-BZ-03, and the DCR-002 evaluation method. Committed alone before any production solve (v2 supersedes v1 before any scored result; see 'supersedes').
what_this_is_not: not a measured field: the result is FE-DERIVED (solver named), never FEMM unless FEMM ran, never 'measured'; measured B(z) on hardware remains an engineering-model verification item (H1F-EX-08 probe path, H1F-MC-09 hot-state reference sensor)
not a Hall simulation and not a Hall performance inference (A9.14 F5-OQ-01 rule 3); no Hall preregistration is edited
not a magnetic-circuit redesign: no registered dimension is changed; elements that are not registered are frozen here as engineering assumptions with a range
not a transport optimum: the band H1F-BZ-03 is a design target, the coil current is an operating variable

solver.femm_check: FEMM is not available in this environment (no wine, no femm / pyfemm executable or module; checked 2026-10-08); no network-policy workaround was attempted. The result is therefore labelled FE-DERIVED (scikit-fem): FEMM-class axisymmetric magnetostatics as authorised by A9.14 F5-OQ-01, not FEMM.
solver.name: scikit-fem (open source, BSD-3-Clause), installed from PyPI
solver.formulation: axisymmetric magnetostatics in the azimuthal vector potential A_phi; weak form int nu [(dA/dr + A/r)(dv/dr + v/r) + dA/dz dv/dz] r dr dz = int J v r dr dz; P2 Lagrange triangles on a tensor (r, z) grid containing every material boundary, r = d_mean / 2 and z = 0, L, 2L; A = 0 on the axis and on the far boundary; B_r = -dA/dz, B_z = dA/dr + A/r
solver.nonlinearity: iron reluctivity nu(|B|) = H(B) / B from the piecewise-linear B-H data (bh_curves_v1.json), saturated slope mu0 beyond the last point; damped Newton with the exact tangent (2 dnu/dB^2 term) and a backtracking line search
solver.convergence_of_one_solve: relative residual ||R||/||F|| < 1e-7 AND relative Newton step < 1e-10 within 60 iterations; otherwise the solve is MODEL_ERROR and no field is returned (fail closed)
solver.code: docs/hardware/h1_bz/h1_bz_fe_solver.py and build_h1_bz_fe.py; their sha256 at run time are recorded in every result (a code change after this lock is recorded; a change to any rule below is a new prereg version)
solver.field_type: vacuum field of the coils + iron (no plasma current, as the P5 vacuum maps); coercivity / remanence neglected (normal curve)

geometry.basis: the registered H2-1 RP-1 lumped magnetic circuit at f_NI 2 (h2_1 coil_design case 'RP-1 f_NI=2'), laid out by its own coil_case rules (build_h2_1_hall_chamber_magnet.py coil_case, read only), with the central bore removed (owner row 79, A9.19 no hollow cathode; H1F-MC-04 'solid (no cathode bore)'). The registered RP-1 inner_core_r_mm 13.0 is kept as the solid-core radius (bore filled with core material; the registered outer dimensions, coil windows and 122 mm body OD are unchanged).
geometry.frame: z along the thrust axis, z = 0 at HALL_INLET_Z0 (anode / distributor face), IP-EXIT at z = L (H1F-CH-01); r from the axis

derived_nominal_layout_mm.channel: r 29..41 (DBF1-H1-04), z 0..103.2; ceramic walls r 25..29 and 41..45 are non-magnetic (air in the model)
derived_nominal_layout_mm.inner pole (FeCo-2V): annular disk r 13..24, z 95.2..103.2 (flush with the exit plane)
derived_nominal_layout_mm.pole gap: r 24..46 = 22 mm = h + 2 t_wall + 2 clearance (h2_1 gap_mm 22)
derived_nominal_layout_mm.inner coil: r 14..23 (build 9), z 6.32..88.88 (82.56 = 0.8 L, centred between back plate and pole)

missing_registered_elements.element: pole-piece contour including the shielding chamfers of the downstream wall edges (T2 magnetically shielded topology)
missing_registered_elements.register: H1F-MC-05 TBD_AFTER_EVIDENCE (requires a shielded-topology FEMM design at the design point)
missing_registered_elements.frozen_here: flat annular exit pole disks of axial thickness w_p, downstream faces flush with z = L, tips at r_in - t_wall - 1 and r_out + t_wall + 1 (the registered H2-1 lumped-circuit geometry)
missing_registered_elements.range: w_p in {5, 8, 10} mm (H2-1 pole_tip_width_mm min / ref / max)
missing_registered_elements.consequence: the FE field is that of the registered pre-shielding MC-1 circuit; a shielded pole design changes the near-wall and anode-region field and is a later design step (a new FE version), not covered by this envelope

missing_registered_elements.element: axial position of the coil windows between the back plate and the poles
missing_registered_elements.register: not registered (H2-1 fixes only the length 0.8 L)
missing_registered_elements.frozen_here: centred in the 0 .. L - w_p space
missing_registered_elements.range: abutting the back plate .. abutting the poles

missing_registered_elements.register: RP-1 inner_core_r_mm 13.0 with an 18 mm bore (h2_1 case 1); row 79 removes the bore; H1F-MC-04 floors are d_mean floors, not a core radius
missing_registered_elements.range: not varied (filling the bore adds iron at unchanged outer dimensions)

missing_registered_elements.register: h2_1 screen_mm 2.0 is a radial allowance ('magnetic screen / heat shield'); no screen part is registered

missing_registered_elements.frozen_here: 0.5 / 0.5; current-controlled supplies make the split an operating variable (H1F-CO-01)
missing_registered_elements.range: 0.4 and 0.6 reported as an operating sensitivity, not part of the uncertainty envelope
BH-LO / BH-NOM / BH-HI permeability bracket only; temperature NOT covered

missing_registered_elements.element: all other parts (ceramic walls, Inconel 600 anode / distributor, ICP module, housing, spacecraft)
missing_registered_elements.frozen_here: non-magnetic (mu_r = 1); Inconel 600 taken as paramagnetic at room temperature (verify against a supplier datum); external magnetic structure not modelled

bh_data.generated_by: docs/hardware/h1_bz/digitize_bh_sources.py from the registered SRC-HIPERCO50 / SRC-ARMCO PDFs (sha256 verified equal to the H2-1 /sources values)

sets.BH-NOM: Hiperco 50 magnetic-anneal table (secant below 400 A/m) + ARMCO Fig. 7 / Fig. 8
sets.BH-LO: Hiperco 50 mechanical-anneal table + ARMCO Fig. 9 lower envelope / Fig. 8
sets.BH-HI: Hiperco 50 at mu_max to 2.0 T + table + ARMCO Fig. 9 upper envelope / Fig. 8

materials.assignment: inner core + inner pole: Hiperco 50 class (H1F-MA-01); back plate + outer core + outer pole: pure iron (H1F-MA-02); coils, walls, anode, air: mu0

V1.what: the nominal H-1 inner coil and outer coil, each alone in air (no iron)
V1.references: on the axis: exact closed form of a uniform rectangular-section coil; at r = 35 mm: Gauss-Legendre quadrature (n x n) of the exact elliptic-integral loop field over the coil section; the elliptic reference is self-checked against the closed form on the axis

V2.what: square-section (1 mm) loop of radius 30 mm at 10 mm above a linear iron half-space z < 0 filling the domain; exact image solution in air: real loop + image loop at -z with current (mu_r - 1)/(mu_r + 1) I

criteria.metric: max |B_FE - B_ref| / max |B_ref| over the evaluation points (air only)

V3.what: infinite solenoid (natural boundaries at the z ends and at the outer radius, A = 0 on the axis) with a nonlinear core of each iron class (BH-NOM): Ampere's law gives H = J t inside the winding, so B_core = B(H) exactly and B_gap = mu0 H

verification.rule: all V1-V3 cases must pass; any failure makes the field FE_DERIVED_NOT_VERIFIED (not registered for use, no DCR proposal)

convergence.rule: converged when every NI row passes L2 vs L3 and the far-boundary check passes; then L3 is the production level of the nominal field and |L2 - L3| per descriptor is carried as the numerical uncertainty of the L2 uncertainty variants; otherwise NUMERICAL_CONVERGENCE_NOT_DEMONSTRATED (not registered, no DCR proposal)

outputs.centreline: B_r(z) and B_z(z) at r = d_mean / 2 = 35 mm, z = 0 .. 2 L (0.1 mm sampling for descriptors)
outputs.peak_vs_current: B_peak and z_peak at every sweep NI; NI at BP-LO / BP-HI / CAP-403 by exact (secant) solves

hallthruster_files.format: as the P5 files: '#' provenance comment lines, header 'z_from_anode_face_mm,Br_G', z = 0 .. 2 L at 0.5 mm
files: nominal at BP-LO, BP-HI, CAP-403 (L3, BH-NOM, exact NI)
the uncertainty variants with the smallest and the largest FWHM at BP-HI (L2)
hallthruster_files.manifest: MANIFEST.json with sha256, NI, level, variant, provenance

uncertainty.method: one-at-a-time over the registered assumption ends plus two corner combinations fixed here before any solve; every variant runs the full NI sweep and the exact BP-LO / BP-HI / CAP-403 solves; envelope = [min, max] over NOM (L3) and all variants (L2), widened by the nominal |L2 - L3| of each descriptor

corners.why: wide gap, thin pole, coils far from the poles, low permeability
narrow gap, thick pole, coils at the poles, high permeability

uncertainty.ranges_source: h2_1 /assumed_inputs t_wall_mm [3, 4, 6], pole_tip_width_mm [5, 8, 10]; coil placement and B-H bracket as frozen above

H1F-BZ-02.target: monotonic rise toward the exit, peak at or just downstream of z = L; field near the anode as low as the circuit allows (numeric B_anode/B_peak TBD; owner tolerance H1F-BZ-05 TBD_OWNER)
H1F-BZ-02.S1: B_r(z) on the centreline never drops by more than 0.5 % of B_peak between z = 0 and the peak
H1F-BZ-02.S2: lane screening reading of 'at or just downstream of z = L': -h/2 <= z_peak - L <= +h (the owner tolerance H1F-BZ-05 remains TBD_OWNER and is not set here)
H1F-BZ-02.S3: B_anode / B_peak reported (no threshold: 'as low as the circuit allows' has no registered number)
H1F-BZ-02.outcome: SHAPE_CONSISTENT if S1 and S2 hold for the nominal field at BP-LO and BP-HI; SHAPE_INCONSISTENT otherwise (reported per criterion); the count of envelope variants meeting S1 / S2 is reported

H1F-BZ-03.target: B_peak band 69.93-268.6 G at / near IP-EXIT; capability 403 G (H1F-BZ-04 / DBF1-BZ-05)
H1F-BZ-03.B1: nominal NI(BP-HI) <= 1040 A-turns (registered RP-1 f_NI 2 total): BAND_REACHABLE_WITHIN_REGISTERED_COIL_NI
H1F-BZ-03.B3: nominal NI(CAP-403) <= 2008 A-turns (registered RP-1 worst-case total): CAPABILITY_WITHIN_REGISTERED_WORST_CASE_NI; envelope reported
H1F-BZ-03.report: per-coil currents at the registered f_NI 2 turns (357 / 157) against the analog 1-5 A window; iron B_max / B_sat at CAP-403

field: MODEL_ERROR (a required solve did not converge)
outcomes.rule: only FE_DERIVED_VERIFIED is registered for use by Hall runs and proposed through DCR-002

dcr_002_evaluation.dbf1_item: DBF1-BZ-04 (simulation B(z) shape, value BZ-P5B16, label SOURCED_SURROGATE_P5_SHAPE_NOT_H1_BZ)
dcr_002_evaluation.reason_known_before_any_solve: DBF1-BD-05: the simulated field is a P5-shape surrogate scaled into the H1F-BZ-03 band; its gradient, high-field width and anode-to-peak ratio (0.201) are P5 properties, not H-1 properties; under the envelope prereg bz_family classification_effect a Hall non-closure under it is never eligible (NOT_DETERMINABLE with blocker H1_BZ_NOT_REGISTERED). An H-1-registered field is the BD-05 closure condition.
dcr_002_evaluation.method: if and only if the field outcome is FE_DERIVED_VERIFIED, DCR-002 proposes replacing DBF1-BZ-04 by the FE-derived H-1 field (nominal L3 profiles at BP-LO and BP-HI, evidence class FE-DERIVED, uncertainty = the envelope); the proposal does not depend on whether the FE shape is favourable or unfavourable for Hall closure, and no Hall / M2 / M3 result is computed or used
comparison_reported: max |B_FE / B_peak,FE - B_surr / B_peak,surr| over z = 0 .. L + 66 mm
dcr_002_evaluation.materiality_flag: informational only: MATERIALLY_DIFFERENT if the max normalised difference > 0.10 or |delta B_anode/B_peak| > 0.05
dcr_002_evaluation.approval: owner decision record (DCR_PROCESS.md) before any Hall rerun uses the FE field; this lane only requests

hall_citation_rule.how: a later Hall run cites a file of hallthruster_bridge/bfield/h1_fe_v1/ with B_profile = {file: 'bfield/h1_fe_v1/<file>', align: 'anode', z_ref_in_file_mm: 0.0, scale_to: 'max'} and B_ref_T = B_peak_G x 1e-4 (the file z is already the H-1 z; no rigid shift)
requires: DCR-002 approved (DBF1-BZ-04 change) and the new DBF baseline locked
a new NP-HALL-PARAMETRIC-ENVELOPE preregistration addendum declaring bz_family kind H1_REGISTERED (FE-DERIVED), registered before the runs it governs; the v1 prereg and earlier addenda are not edited
the MANIFEST sha256 of the cited file
hall_citation_rule.never: surrogate (BZ-P5B16 / P5B30) and FE-derived results are never pooled or relabelled; records computed under the surrogate stay surrogate records

change_control: any change to a rule, criterion, range, mesh level or variant after the lock is a new dated prereg version; results seen under v1 cannot justify a v1 change

supersedes.only_change: solver.convergence_of_one_solve: relative residual tolerance 1e-9 -> 1e-7 and relative Newton step tolerance 1e-9 -> 1e-10. Every geometry, material, mesh, verification, convergence, uncertainty, acceptance, DCR-002 and citation rule is identical to v1.
supersedes.reason: under v1 the V3 verification solves (infinite solenoid, nonlinear core) stalled at a relative residual of 2e-9 with relative Newton steps of 1e-17, i.e. at the double-precision residual floor of an iron/air system (reluctivity contrast ~1e3-1e4): the v1 residual tolerance 1e-9 is below what the arithmetic can resolve, and the solver reported MODEL_ERROR (line search cannot decrease a round-off residual). 1e-7 stays four orders of magnitude below the tightest verification criterion (V3 1e-3); the step tolerance is tightened to keep the convergence test strict.
results_seen_before_v2: v1 verify stage: crashed at the first V3 case (MODEL_ERROR returned by the solver, then a TypeError in the stage runner when reading the missing field); no V1 / V2 / V3 error value was computed or printed
v1 convergence stage (killed after two solves): L1 (2 mm mesh) nominal geometry, B_peak 118.57 G at 260 A-turns and 475.85 G at 1040 A-turns, z_peak 99.18 mm, B_anode/B_peak -0.0016 / -0.0009
V3 debug: Newton status / residual / step only (no comparison with the exact solution)
code_changes_with_v2: build_h1_bz_fe.py: a MODEL_ERROR verification solve is recorded as a failed case instead of crashing; v2 prereg / lock paths
